description: Animate an AvatarSay character avatar (ast_...) with lip-synced speech in 40+ languages using one of 8 preset voices. New accounts get their first short talking clip (<=5s / <=75 chars) for 0 credits! Subsequent or longer clips cost 12 account credits per second of speech (minimum 5s = 60 credits, maximum 30s). Enqueues asynchronously and returns jobId immediately — never blocks for the 3–5 minute render. Poll get_job every 20–30 seconds for the watermark-free 960×960 MP4 URL. Failed renders refund credits automatically. Requires Authorization: Bearer avs_...

assetId.description: AvatarSay character asset ID (ast_...) from generate_avatars -> get_job, import_character_portrait, or list_avatars. Camera photos of real people are not supported.

language.description: Optional language hint for pronunciation (default "auto", supporting 40+ languages): auto, English, Russian, French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Ukrainian.

script.description: Spoken dialogue line in any supported language (2–400 chars, up to 30 seconds of speech; <=75 chars qualifies for the 0-credit first clip on new accounts).

voice.description: Built-in multilingual voice ID: Friendly_Person, Wise_Woman, Lively_Girl, Calm_Woman, Casual_Guy, Deep_Voice_Man, Patient_Man, Young_Knight.

name: create_talking_video
title: Create Lip-Synced Talking Character Video
